title: Authorization check uses substring membership, allowing privilege confusion
description: In core/access.py, check_permission() compares the user's role to the required role with `if required in role` where required is a string. Any role whose name contains the required string passes the check, so a user with role 'xadmin' is granted access to an endpoint guarded by required='admin'. The comparison should be exact, or a set membership against an explicit role list.
poc_text: Assign a user the role 'xadmin' and call an endpoint guarded by required='admin'; the substring check passes.
